table.retrieve:
SELECT 
		itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END,   
         aliasname=item.customicode,   
		manfdate=(select min(manfdate) from purdetail where purdetail.icode=saledetail.icode AND purdetail.batch=saledetail.batch),
		salecatcode=max(saleledger.salecatcode),   
         accname =max( dbo.accounts.name),   
         address =max( dbo.customer.address1),   
         address2= max(dbo.customer.address2), 
         salesman = max(dbo.users.username),   
		doctor=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=max(saleledger.doctcode)),
         saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno, 
		headerinvno=max(saleledger.headerinvno), 
         date = max(dbo.saleledger.date),   
         invdiscperc =max( dbo.saleledger.discperc),   
         misccharges =max( dbo.saleledger.misccharges),   
         flatdisc = max(dbo.saleledger.flatdisc),   
         invsalestax =max( dbo.saleledger.salestax),   
         gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         batch = max(saledetail.batch),   
         expiry =min( saledetail.expiry),   
         looseqty =sum( saledetail.looseqty),   
         bonusqty =sum( saledetail.bonusqty),   
         packqty =sum( saledetail.packqty),   
         packunits=max( saledetail.packunits),   
         saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
         discperc = saledetail.discperc,   
         salestax =max( saledetail.salestax),   
			itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,  
         Id = max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),   
         posted=max(saleledger.posted),   
         balance=isnull(max(saleledger.balance),0),
			amt=max(saleledger.amt),   
         unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = max(saleledger.invgstperc1),   
         custTaxRegno=max(customer.salestaxregno ) ,
			custrefno=max(saleledger.custrefno),	
			remarks=max(saleledger.remarks),
			printwaranty=max(saleledger.printwaranty),
			printbatch=max(saleledger.printbatch),
			printbalance=max(saleledger.printbalance),			
			messagedesc=(select description from message where messagecode=max(saleledger.messagecode)),
			salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=max(saleledger.smancode)),
			custcode=saleledger.custcode,
			reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
			serverdate=getdate(),
			patientname=(select name from patient where patientcode=max(saleledger.patientcode)),
			regno=(select regno from patient where patientcode=max(saleledger.patientcode)),
			patientadd1=(select address1 from patient where patientcode=max(saleledger.patientcode)),
			patientadd2=(select address2 from patient where patientcode=max(saleledger.patientcode)),
			patientmobile1=(select mobileno1 from patient where patientcode=max(saleledger.patientcode))

    FROM saleledger,   
         saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleledger.date, 
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.headerno,
			saleledger.salestax, 
			saleledger.remarks, 
			saledetail.icode, 
			saledetail.saleprice,
			saledetail.discperc,
			saledetail.itemflatdisc,
			saledetail.gstperc,
			saledetail.unitsalestax,
			saledetail.batch,
			saledetail.expiry,
			saledetail.gcode, 
			item.name,
			item.customicode,
			item.icode,
			item.printable,
			users.username
ORDER BY MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 -invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) )
